🚀 Installation & Quick Start

After Download

1. Extract ZIP

$ unzip sovran-library.zip
$ cd sovran

2. Install in Julia

$ julia --project=.
julia> using Pkg
julia> Pkg.instantiate()

3. Run Tests

julia> Pkg.test()
# ✓ All tests passed

4. Start Using

julia> using Sovran
julia> Sovran.version()
"1.0.0-rc1"

Quick Start Code

quickstart.jl 
using Sovran
using Sovran.Tensor
using Sovran.NN

# Create tensors
a = Tensor(rand(Float32, 100, 100))
b = Tensor(rand(Float32, 100, 100))

# Matrix multiplication
c = matmul(a, b)

# Neural network
model = Sequential(
    Dense(784, 256, :relu),
    Dense(256, 128, :relu),
    Dense(128, 10, :softmax)
)

println("SOVRAN is working! 🌀")
💡 Tip: Run julia examples/quickstart.jl to test your installation
